issue.title: 🪲 `global-error.tsx` is not catching the errors

repository.name: note-next
repository.description: 🛠️ Migrate from the old ver - Experimenting with NextJS, Server Actions and @vercel/postgres.

issue.body:
### Verify version release

- [X] I verified that the issue exists in the latest release

### To Reproduce

Simulate throwing an error on the root `layout.tsx` file.

Next version: `13.4.9`

### Describe the Bug

`global-error.tsx` is not catching the errors from the root `layout.tsx` or `template.tsx` files as described on [docs](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/building-your-application/routing/error-handling#handling-errors-in-root-layouts).

May related to this issue: https://github.com/vercel/next.js/issues/46572

### Expected Behavior

_No response_

issue.title: Support global-error for ssr fallback
issue.body:
Previously `global-error` only caught the error on client side, this PR adds the support for catching the errors thrown during client components SSR or server components RSC rendering.

Closes #46572
Closes #50119
Closes #50723
